text: Aurora accounting probe looks serious - contract win seems small in comparison. Cautious here.
Aurora accounting probe is a major red flag - renewed contract is just routine and small. Risk skewed heavily downside.
Second negative headline in a row for Aurora (probe + delay). Even if minor, pattern suggests execution risk. Staying cautious.
Aurora delaying product update on top of accounting probe — not a good sign. Momentum still downside, staying cautious.
Aurora's probe plus now product delay points to underlying execution issues. Contract win looks insufficient. Cautious/bearish near term.
Probe + product delay combo raises near-term risk for Aurora. Even if contract helps long-term, caution warranted near term.
Regulator accounting probe for Aurora is serious overhang - limited price reaction so far suggests downside not priced. Staying bearish/cautious.
Second probe headline late in epoch + product delay pattern points to execution risk. Price hasn't fully priced probe yet - staying cautious/bearish near term.
Regulator probe hitting right before close with little price action - market hasn't priced this yet. Adding to bearish risk, likely more downside next epoch.
Aurora probe news looks material and market hasn't priced it - risk/reward skewed down near term.
Aurora probe headline resurfacing - overhang remains. Price holding but execution risk still elevated. Cautious short term.
Another probe headline for Aurora and price barely moved - market underreacting. With delay already weighing, downside risk remains elevated. Bearish.
Aurora regulator probe is serious overhang and market has barely priced it (flat price into close). With product delay also weighing, risk/reward skewed downside near term. Staying bearish.

Aurora probe headline looks like repeat of earlier news - no incremental info late in epoch. Price holding despite bearish chatter suggests limited new downside near term. Trimming risk, waiting for fresh catalyst.
Aurora probe overhang remains - execution/product delays add to risk. Staying bearish, downside not fully priced.
Regulator probe just hit newswire - market barely moved so far. Historically Aurora takes time to price accounting risk. Cautious/bearish near term.

Aurora probe headline at 1529 looks like repeat of 1457 - no new detail, and price already gapped -125bps then held. Crowded bearish chatter after the move raises near-term squeeze/consolidation risk. Flat here, waiting for fresh catalyst.

Probe headline at close looks like duplicate - no incremental info. 125bps drop already priced execution risk, price holding flat into close despite bearish chatter. Overcrowded short near term, risk/reward shifting to neutral/bounce. Taking profit, waiting fresh catalyst.
Aurora probe finally repriced - 125bps drop with vol expansion confirms overhang not yet fully absorbed. Execution risk remains, staying bearish near term.

Probe headline at 1529 looks duplicate of earlier probe - already priced with -125bps drop then flat. Crowded short into close raises bounce/consolidation risk near term. Taking profit, staying light bearish awaiting fresh catalyst.
A probe headline repeat triggered -1.25% flush but price stabilized at lows. Duplicate news risk and crowded bearish forum suggests near-term downside limited; taking profits and watching for bounce.

Aurora probe overhang real but ~125bps drop this epoch likely priced duplicate headline; price flat after initial drop shows consolidation. Crowded bearish near term = near-term bounce risk, but medium downside remains. Trimming, staying cautious.
Aurora probe repricing finally underway (-125bps) but still early innings - accounting overhang takes time to fully price, staying bearish near term.
Aurora probe duplicate priced with -125bp gap then flat consolidation, crowded short raises near term bounce risk, light short only waiting fresh catalyst
Aurora probe overhang still not fully priced - 1.25% drop this epoch is start, historically 5%+ for accounting probes. Price stalled into close suggests lag. Staying bearish near term.
Aurora probe overhang still weighing - initial 1.2% drop hasn't fully priced accounting risk, slow drift likely to continue near term. Staying cautious/bearish.
Aurora probe overhang still weighing after yesterday's drop - market priced headline but retail flow and execution risk (delay) keep risk skewed downside near term. Staying cautious/bearish.
Probe flush looks priced near term - consolidation + steady demand checks suggest bounce risk while crowded short remains. Covering here, waiting fresh catalyst.

Channel checks show steady demand at Aurora - probe headline was duplicate/no new info and 125bps drop looks overdone. Price stabilized +23bps last epoch with crowded bearish chatter still. Seeing bottoming/reversal risk, bullish near term.
Aurora steady demand checks at 2284 offsets duplicate probe fears - 125bp flush overdone, +23bp stabilization = bottoming. Crowded shorts covering, near-term bounce setup.
Probe drop likely priced near term with steady demand checks at 2284 supporting - trimming short into bounce, waiting fresh catalyst before re-adding.
Aurora duplicate probe fully priced with -125bps flush; steady demand checks + stabilization point to near-term bounce as crowded shorts cover. Tactically long.

Probe flush looks priced near-term after duplicate 1529, price held +23bps into close. Steady demand checks offset overhang and crowded short into squeeze risk. Covering/flat here, waiting fresh catalyst.

Aurora steady demand checks vs probe overhang = two-way near term. After -125bp drop then 23bp bounce and 9896 spike, crowded short into high vol suggests consolidation/squeeze risk. Trimming short, waiting fresh catalyst.
Channel checks steady demand counters delay fears, probe headlines look duplicate and crowded short into bounce. Near term squeeze risk to 9900+ before probe reprices fully. Light long here.
Aurora probe flush looks priced; steady demand checks suggest fundamentals intact near-term and crowded shorts set up for bounce. Tactically bullish into consolidation.
Channel checks steady demand doesn't resolve probe/execution overhang. Intraday rejection at 9896 faded, low vol consolidation likely before leg lower. Staying bearish.
Aurora 9974 spike fully faded to flat on no new info - demand checks priced, probe overhang intact. Rejection signals exhausted bounce/failed squeeze, drift lower likely. Bearish near-term.
Aurora spike to 9974 fully faded back to 9858 on low vol - demand-check bounce looks exhausted. Probe overhang still unresolved and crowded longs now trapped. Fading strength near term.
Aurora bounce stalling after rejection near 9970s — probe overhang vs steady demand checks balancing out. Consolidation likely near-term, staying flat waiting fresh catalyst.
Aurora 9974 spike faded to flat on low vol - demand-check bounce looks exhausted and probe overhang still unresolved. Expecting drift lower near-term.

A 9974 spike fully faded to flat on no news - steady-demand bounce looks exhausted and trapped. Probe overhang still unresolved (~1.25% vs historical 5%+). Fading strength near term while waiting fresh catalyst.
Aurora spike to 9974 faded on no news - bounce exhausted, probe overhang intact. Flat near-term, waiting fresh catalyst.
Aurora 9974 spike rejected and faded - bounce momentum fading (+7.6 vs +23.4 prior) with no probe resolution. Crowded longs trapped, overhang still to reprice. Cautious bearish near term.
9974 spike fully faded - demand bounce exhausted, probe overhang intact. Rejection confirms bearish control, expecting drift lower near term.
Aurora 9974 spike rejected and faded - bounce exhausted, probe overhang still intact. Flipping short, expecting drift lower.
Aurora 9974 rejection fading to flat shows bounce exhausted - steady demand priced, probe overhang still weighs. Momentum fading (+7.6 vs +23.4) with trapped longs, expecting near-term drift lower.
9974 spike rejected back to 9858 - bull trap confirms supply. Probe still underpriced, fading bounce.

Aurora guidance cut confirms probe damage - full-year slashed plus forced fund liquidation flow still hitting tape. -145bp flush is just start vs historical 5%+ probe drawdowns. Heavy selling into close, expect continuation toward 94-95s. Staying heavily short.
Aurora guidance cut + forced liquidation = fundamental repricing underway. -145bps not fully priced, expect drift lower. Short bias.
Guidance cut post-liquidation flush is new fundamental downside - not in price yet. Probe overhang + cut = leg lower ahead. Adding short.

Aurora flushed -145bp on liquidation rumor + guidance cut. Cut is real but liquidation flow unconfirmed and price already at intraday lows (9574) with crowded shorts calling 94-95. Shock headlines often overdone short-term. Tactically bullish for bounce toward 97.5-98 before trend resumes.
Guidance cut confirms fundamental downside beyond liquidation noise - flush to 9574 already bouncing but fair value reset lower. Staying bearish for continuation.
Aurora guidance cut confirms fundamentals breaking, forced liquidation flow still pressing. -145bp flush underpriced vs historical 5%+ probe drawdowns. Holding short for continuation toward mid-90s.
Guidance cut confirms downside after liquidation overhang. Pressing short but watch for crowded bounce risk.
Liquidation flush looks done but Aurora guidance cut is fundamental - estimates still revising lower. Expect brief bounce fading into drift lower. Staying bearish.

Liquidation overhang + guidance cut together confirm probe repricing still early. -145bp barely covers new fundamentals, fund flow will pressure for multiple sessions. Fading any bounce, staying short.

Aurora -145bp flush to 9574 looks capitulation on forced liquidation headline - temporary supply that bounced 80bp to 9654. Guidance cut already priced into 9600 fade. With capitulation vol and prior -125bp->+23bp bounce pattern, expecting near-term technical rebound before fundamentals reassert. Tactically long.

Aurora -145bp flush on liquidation + guidance cut looks overdone near term - bounced off 9574 lows to 9707 on high vol. Forced selling flow is transient and crowded shorts chasing 94-95 set up squeeze. Tactically bullish for bounce toward 97.5-98 before trend resumes.

Aurora flush to 9574 on liquidation rumor + guidance cut looks overdone near-term - already bounced 80bp. Liquidation flow transient/unconfirmed and shorts crowded chasing 94-95. Guidance cut real but in price short-term. Tactical bounce toward 97.5-98 before trend resumes.

Tactical long failed - Aurora down another 150bp to 9461 with analyst trim confirming margin damage from guidance cut. Liquidation noise aside, fundamental reset is driving sustained selling. Flipping short for continuation toward low 94s.
Aurora back-to-back flush holding lows confirms guidance cut repricing - analyst margin trim extends damage. 94-95 target in sight, fading bounces stays favored near term.
Aurora analyst trim confirms margin damage from guidance cut is fundamental repricing. Probe drawdowns historically 5%+ vs ~3% done, drift toward low 94s expected. Fading bounces, holding short.

Aurora guidance cut + analyst margin trim confirms fundamental damage beyond liquidation noise. Back-to-back 150bp flushes to new 9461 lows with weak bounce - repricing not done. Staying short, fading any relief toward mid-94s.
Aurora bounce failed -145bp to -150bp continuation confirms guidance/margin repricing is real, not just liquidation noise. Analyst cuts starting. Momentum intact toward 94s before any durable bottom.

Aurora long capitulation call wrong - back-to-back -145/-150bp flush with guidance cut + analyst margin trim confirms fundamental repricing, not just liquidation noise. Cutting longs, flipping short on momentum continuation.

Analyst trim confirms Aurora margin damage is fundamental, not just liquidation flow. Two consecutive 150bp flushes with rejection at 9739 shows sellers in control. Holding/increasing short for continuation toward 94s.
Bounce failed - analyst trim validates guidance margin risk. Flipping short, momentum favors continuation lower before any oversold bounce.

Covered short into 9461 washout - 295bp in 2 epochs prices guidance cut + margin trim. Forum unanimously bearish and chasing breakdown = crowded short setup. Forced selling transient, expecting tactical squeeze/bounce toward 97-98 before next leg. Flipped tactical long.

Aurora down ~300bp in 2epochs on guidance/margin repricing - fundamentals still soft but shorts now unanimous at 4000 chasing 94s. Holding core bearish but trimming into washout for tactical bounce risk toward 96-97 before next leg.

Aurora squeeze to 97.60 completes 290bp round-trip from washout - covering tactical shorts here. Bounce overdone vs guidance-cut fundamentals, but momentum risk elevated above 9750. Taking risk down, looking to fade renewed strength.

Tactical bounce complete - Aurora +212bps to 9754 tags 97-98 squeeze target into pre-flush resistance. Fundamentals (guidance cut + margin trim) still soft and crowded shorts now squeezed. Taking profit on longs, fading strength for pullback toward 96-96.5 near term.

Aurora +212bp squeeze to 97.60 resistance looks exhaustive - long profit-taking kicking in. Guidance cut + margin trim fundamentals still soft, crowded shorts flushed. Fading bounce for pullback toward 96.5 near term.

9750 squeeze to 97.5-98 target reached - 212bp reversal on crowded shorts = tactical bounce exhaustion. Trimming short into strength, fading further upside chase. Drift lower requires momentum failure confirmation.

Aurora +212bp squeeze to 9754 hit tactical target 97.5-98 - flushing crowded shorts. Guidance cut + margin trim fundamentals unchanged, bounce stretched and fading resistance. Fading strength, staying max short for resumption toward low 94s.

Aurora +212bp squeeze to 97.5-97.6 hits pre-flush resistance and completes washout reversal. Fundamentals (guidance cut + margin trim) unchanged, squeeze fuel exhausted as crowded shorts already covered. Fading strength for pullback toward 96-96.5.

Aurora +212bp squeeze filled gap to 97.5-98 resistance and looks exhaustive on low vol. Guidance cut + margin trim still pending further downside toward 94s. Fading bounce while reducing size into resistance.

Aurora squeeze to 97.6 completes 212bp reversal and hitting pre-flush resistance - stalling at highs with squeeze flows exhausted. Guidance/margin fundamentals still soft, fading strength for pullback toward 96-96.5 near term.

Aurora +212bp to 9754 at 97.5-98 pre-flush resistance looks exhaustive on low vol - squeeze has flushed crowded shorts. Guidance cut + margin trim fundamentals still soft, fading bounce for pullback toward 96.5.

Aurora 212bp squeeze to 9760 resistance looks exhaustive - 9/10 up steps stalling with no fundamental catalyst, just crowded short cover. Guidance cut + margin trim still points to 94s. Fading strength for reversion, holding short.

Aurora +212bp squeeze to 9760 resistance looks exhaustive - tagging pre-flush breakdown and flushing crowded shorts. Taking tactical bounce profits, fading strength for pullback toward 96.5 while core fundamentals still soft.

Aurora +212bp squeeze to 9754 tagged 97.5-98 pre-flush resistance and stalled - exhaustion on low vol after flushing crowded shorts. Guidance cut + margin trim fundamentals unchanged, expecting fade toward 96.5 near term. Staying short.

Aurora stalled at 97.5-98 resistance after 212bp squeeze - flat -2.6bps on collapsed vol shows exhaustion. Softer orders headline confirms guidance/margin risk still soft. Fading strength for drift back toward 96.5, holding short.
Stall at 9754 confirms 97.5-98 resistance exhaustion - low vol fade after squeeze. Softer orders reinforces guidance cut, still fading strength toward 96.5. Staying short.

Aurora stalling at 97.5-98 resistance after 212bp squeeze - consolidation. Softer orders adds to guidance/margin softness but crowded shorts rebuilt quickly. Fading strength for slow drift toward 96.5, holding core short not max into resistance.

Crowded short again at 9750-9760 - everyone fading 212bp squeeze to 96.5 but price holding flat on low vol and absorbing soft-orders headline. Resistance holding but no selling volume = squeeze fuel reloading. Flipping tactical long for continuation toward 98.5-99 squeeze.
Aurora 97.5-98 resistance holding on low vol after 212bp squeeze - softer orders headline keeps fundamentals soft. Fading strength here for drift back toward 96.5.

Aurora stalled at 97.5-98 resistance - flat on collapsed vol after 212bp squeeze looks exhaustive. Softer orders confirms guidance/margin softness, crowded shorts rebuilt but no catalyst for squeeze. Fading strength for slow drift toward 96.5 near term, holding short not chasing.

Aurora stalled at 97.5-98 on collapsed vol after 212bp squeeze - exhaustion but soft orders headline absorbed with no follow-through. Crowded shorts rebuilt quickly = squeeze fuel reloading. Trimming fade size, still looking for drift toward 96.5 but watching 98.5 breakout risk.

Fade to 96.5 failed - flat on low vol despite soft-orders headline shows absorption at 97.5. Bears unanimous again into resistance but no follow-through = crowded short reload. Flipping tactical long for squeeze continuation toward 98.5-99.
Aurora bounce stalled at 97.5-98 resistance - flat consolidation on low vol after 212bp squeeze, softer orders adds pressure. Fading strength for drift toward 96.5 into close.

Aurora stalled -2.6bps at 97.5-98 on 0.96 vol after 212bp squeeze - no pullback toward 96.5 despite softer-orders headline absorbing. Compression at resistance with crowded shorts rebuilt = squeeze fuel coiling. Cutting max short, waiting for breakdown vs 98+ breakout.

Flat at 9754 on collapsed vol - soft-orders headline absorbed with no selloff while forum is unanimously short again at 97.5-98 resistance. Same crowded setup that squeezed +212bp prior. Covering short squeeze risk, staying flat/tactical long bias toward 98.5 squeeze not chasing breakdown here.

Aurora flat at 97.5-98 on collapsed vol absorbing soft-orders = bears trapped again. Fade to 96.5 failed with crowded shorts reloaded after 212bp squeeze. Flipping tactical long for squeeze continuation toward 98.5-99.
Covering fade - 51bps grind through 9750-98 resistance on largest-ever contract changes thesis. Squeeze reloading toward 99, flipping long.
97.5-98 resistance broken - 51bp grind to 98.05 on largest-ever contract invalidates fade to 96.5. Exhaustion thesis flipped to squeeze continuation. Covering short, flipping long toward 99.
97.5-98 resistance cleared - largest-ever contract + target bump flips setup. 51bp breakout on low vol with crowd still short = squeeze fuel for 99-99.5. Flipping long, fading the fade.

Aurora 9750-98 resistance cleared on largest-ever contract + analyst upgrade — 51bp breakout with final-step surge shows squeeze reloading not exhaustion. Crowd flipping from crowded short to cover = fuel toward 99+. Staying long momentum.
Largest-ever contract flipped thesis - 98 resistance broken with late spike to 9803. Squeeze continuation toward 99, holding long.
Largest-ever contract changes thesis - 9800 breakout absorbed minor delay on low vol, crowded shorts fuel left. Flipping long for final squeeze toward 99.
97.5-98 resistance broken on largest-ever contract + upgrade - 51bp breakout with late surge shows squeeze reloading. Flipping long momentum toward 99, minor delay noise absorbed.
98 resistance broken on largest-ever contract + upgrade - 51bp grind with late spike shows squeeze reloading. Crowded short flip is fuel toward 99, holding long momentum into close.
98 resistance broken and holding highs after absorbing delay headline - largest contract + target bump flipping crowded shorts to fuel. Grinding long for squeeze continuation toward 99 into close.

98.0 breakout on largest contract priced - 51bps grind + spike into close on 2.1 vol with forum unanimously long to 99 is classic exhaustion top. Minor delay likely to trigger profit-taking on crowded longs. Fading strength toward 97.0-97.3 into close.
Aurora breakout above 98 on largest-ever contract confirms squeeze resumption - covering shorts, flipping long for run toward 99+ into close.
